Alger, 21 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 21, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The National Organ for the Protection and Promotion of Childhood (ONPPE) has established a unit dedicated to monitoring digital risks. This structure aims to coordinate the prevention of cyberbullying and online child exploitation.
Création d'une cellule de vigilance au s: Creation of a vigilance unit within the ONPPE
L'Algérie renforce son dispositif instit: Algeria is strengthening its institutional framework for the protection of minors with the establishment of a cyber vigilance unit. This new structure, attached to the National Organ for the Protection and Promotion of Childhood (ONPPE), was announced by the National Delegate for Child Protection, Aida Mecheri, on the occasion of World Children's Day on November 20.
Cette initiative répond à l'augmentation: This initiative responds to the increase in digital risks to which children are exposed, notably cyberbullying, blackmail, and dangerous interactions with strangers. The unit's mission is to detect threats upstream, facilitate the circulation of information, and coordinate the interventions of the various stakeholders involved. It relies on a monitoring, tracking, and coordination mechanism designed to identify early dangers in the digital space.
La structure agit comme un espace de tra: The structure acts as a joint working space allowing the pooling of expertise between institutions and security services. The objective is to better prevent situations of exploitation, violence, and blackmail on the Internet, facilitated by the growing use of social networks and video game platforms.
Cette création s'inscrit dans la continu: This creation is in line with the actions already carried out by the Algerian authorities. Since 2024, the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications has been organizing awareness campaigns in schools on Internet-related dangers. In April 2025, the Information Systems Security Agency also conducted educational activities on cybersecurity for primary school students.
La rencontre de présentation a également: The presentation meeting also provided an opportunity to outline the legal framework, composition, and operating procedures of this new unit. Furthermore, the security services detailed their actions against cybercrime, supplementing the ONPPE's existing mechanisms for collecting reports and supporting vulnerable children.
